title: IFR Flight Planning Made Easy: Rotterdam to Madrid Tutorial 🛩️🛬
description:
Welcome back to our flight planning series! In this video, we take a deep dive into planning IFR (Instrument Flight Rules) flights using Little Navmap. If you’ve been following along, you know we’ve already covered the basics with a short flight. Now, it’s time to elevate your skills with a comprehensive tutorial on planning a longer journey from Rotterdam to Madrid. 🌍🛫

What You’ll Learn:

Step-by-step guidance on planning an IFR flight using Little Navmap. 📝
How to incorporate a Standard Instrument Departure (SID) into your flight plan. 🛩️
Adding a Standard Terminal Arrival Route (STAR) for a smooth approach. 🌟
Detailed instructions on setting up your approach to Madrid. 🛬
Whether you’re a seasoned pilot or just getting started, this tutorial will provide you with the knowledge and confidence to plan longer IFR flights with ease. Don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more in-depth tutorials and flight planning tips! 👍📺
